title: Inter's Lautaro Martinez has a hamstring strain - Gazzetta says five to six weeks
caption:
Inter say Lautaro Martinez has a strain in his left hamstring, and gave no return date. Gazzetta dello Sport, via FCInter1908, calls it a tear and expects five to six weeks out. Inter play at Bologna on Saturday, 12:00 PM ET. Esposito or Bonny beside Thuram?
